name: Area Readiness
description: Is this area finished? Every step is something a player would notice the absence of.

steps.label: Twenty rooms
steps.hint: `dig <dir> <title>` builds outward from where you stand.

steps.label: Every room reachable
steps.hint: A room nobody can walk to is a room nobody sees. `link` connects it.

steps.label: Five mobile prototypes
steps.hint: `medit create <name>` claims a new one for you.

steps.label: Things actually appear
steps.hint: Prototypes without spawn points never enter the world. `spedit`.

steps.label: A reason to come here
steps.hint: `quedit create <vnum> <name>`, then hang it on a mobile with `medit ... dialogue`.

steps.label: A level range set
steps.hint: `aedit levels <min> <max>` — nothing else tells players who this is for.

steps.label: Eight rooms in ten grade C or better
steps.hint: `build audit area` lists the worst first.
